headline: F1 Tonga's income tax rates are not in the published revised edition: they sit in a Ministerial Order that the Attorney-General's site does not carry

scale.source: Income Tax (Amendment) Order 2017 para 2 (in force 1 July 2017): start of the 20 % band ("$30,001-$60,000 20%")
scale.basis: Income Tax (Amendment) Order 2017 para 2 (in force 1 July 2017): start of the 20 % band ("$30,001-$60,000 20%"). A statutory threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act 2007' confirmed (Cap. 11.05); the rates are not in the Act but in a Ministerial Order under s 5(1): Income Tax (Amendment) Order 2017, 0 % to 10,000, 10 % to 30,000, 20 % to 60,000, 25 % above; fiscal year ending 30 June; NRBF employee 5 % (not deductible); dividends exempt.

d9_review.cause: rates changed from 1 July 2021 (Ministry PAYE notice: 0 % to 12,000, 10 % to 30,000, 15 % to 50,000, 20 % to 70,000, 25 % above); model has the 2017 Order
d9_review.instrument: not reached; the gazetted Income Tax (Amendment) Order 2021 (Supp. Extra. No. 21, 30 June 2021) is a World Bank employees exemption, not the rates
